scripts.backend:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml up -d --build --wait && docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml exec -T app php artisan db:seed --class=E2ETestAdminSeeder --force && docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml exec -T app php artisan db:seed --class=E2EFixtureSeeder --force
scripts.backend:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v && npm run backend:up
